metas.name: The Muppet Show
metas.description: Kermit and friends return in a modern take on their classic variety show format, mixing nostalgic charm with new comedy bits while staying true to the Muppets' timeless spirit.

metas.name: The Investigation of Lucy Letby
metas.description: Unseen footage and unheard insider accounts reveal the harrowing and divisive Case of Lucy Letby, the neonatal nurse convicted of fatally harming infants.

metas.name: Send Help
metas.description: An overworked analyst and her arrogant nepo-baby boss survive a plane crash near Thailand and must cooperate to survive on a remote jungle island while their workplace power dynamic collapses around them.

metas.name: Shelter
metas.description: A reclusive former government assassin finds his forced isolation shattered when a stranded supply girl triggers a lethal tracking system, forcing him to defend her against his old handler's relentless execution squads.

metas.name: The Wrecking Crew
metas.description: Estranged half brothers Jonny, a volatile suspended cop, and James, a disciplined Navy SEAL, reluctantly reunite in Hawaii after their private investigator father is murdered, triggering a dangerous clash with Yakuza operatives.

metas.name: Mercy
metas.description: Set in the near future, a detective accused of murdering his wife has 90 minutes to prove his innocence to an advanced AI judge.

metas.name: Return to Silent Hill
metas.description: When a man receives a mysterious letter from his lost love, he is drawn to Silent Hill, a once familiar town now consumed by darkness.

metas.name: The Testament of Ann Lee
metas.description: Ann Lee, the founding leader of the Shaker Movement, is proclaimed the priestess by her church. This film depicts her establishment of a Utopian society and the Shakers' worship through song and dance, based on real events.

metas.name: The Big Fake
metas.description: Rome, 1970s. When Toni arrives in the city with the dream of becoming a great artist. But his hunger for life, destiny and perhaps even History will lead him to become the greatest of all forgers.

metas.name: The Last First: Winter K2
metas.description: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

metas.name: Cosmic Princess Kaguya!
metas.description: 17-year-old Iroha leads a busy life juggling school and part-time work. Enter Kaguya, a mysterious girl from the moon who crash-lands into her life.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

metas.name: The Rip
metas.description: A group of Miami cops discovers a stash of millions in cash, leading to distrust as outsiders learn about the huge seizure, making them question who to rely on.

metas.name: No Other Choice
metas.description: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

metas.name: Dead Man's Wire
metas.description: On February 8, 1977, Tony Kiritsis entered the office of Richard Hall, president of the Meridian Mortgage Company, and took him hostage with a sawed-off shotgun wired with a "dead man's wire" from the trigger to Tony's own neck.

metas.name: A Private Life
metas.description: The renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner mounts a private investigation into the death of one of her patients, whom she is convinced has been murdered.

metas.name: Sound of Falling
metas.description: A remote German farm harbors generations of secrets. Four women, separated by decades but united by trauma, uncover the truth behind its weathered walls.

metas.name: People We Meet on Vacation
metas.description: Poppy wants to explore the world and Alex prefers to stay home with a good book, but somehow they are the very best of friends. They live far apart, but for a decade they have spent one week of summer vacation together.

metas.name: The Plague
metas.description: A socially awkward tween endures the ruthless hierarchy at a water polo camp, his anxiety spiraling into psychological turmoil over the summer.

metas.name: The Tank
metas.description: The five-man crew of a German Tiger tank is sent on a secret mission far behind the fiercely contested front line. Fueled by the Wehrmacht's methamphetamine, their mission increasingly becomes a journey into the heart of darkness.

metas.name: Ricky Gervais: Mortality
metas.description: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.

metas.name: Violent Ends
metas.description: A southern revenge thriller of star-crossed lovers set against the backdrop of the Ozark Mountains, Violent Ends chronicles the life of Lucas Frost, an honest man brought up in a crime family whose only legacy is violence.

metas.name: Cover-Up
metas.description: Seymour Hersh has been at the front lines of political journalism in the United States. Hersh's breakthrough reportage has brought to the public's attention many of the most damning constitutional wrongdoings and cover-ups.

metas.name: Marty Supreme
metas.description: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.

metas.name: Song Sung Blue
metas.description: Lightning and Thunder, a Milwaukee husband and wife Neil Diamond tribute act, experience soaring success and devastating heartbreak in their musical journey together.

metas.name: Anaconda
metas.description: A group of friends are going through a mid-life crisis. They decide to remake a favorite movie from their youth but encounter unexpected events when they enter the jungle.

metas.name: Goodbye June
metas.description: Follows a group of fractured siblings who must come together under sudden and trying circumstances.

metas.name: Father Mother Sister Brother
metas.description: Estranged siblings reunite after years apart, forced to confront unresolved tensions and reevaluate their strained relationships with their emotionally distant parents

metas.name: The Housemaid
metas.description: Millie a struggling young woman becomes live-in maid for a wealthy couple Nina and Andrew. She enters a mansion of secrets, manipulation, and escalating psychological games that pull her into a dangerous relationship dynamic.

metas.name: Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

metas.name: Is This Thing On?

metas.name: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable
metas.description: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.

metas.name: David
metas.description: From his mother's songs to his clash with Goliath, David's journey from humble shepherd to anointed king tests the limits of faith, courage, and love--culminating in a battle for the soul of a kingdom.

metas.name: The Great Flood
metas.description: A disastrous great flood sweeps the planet. On what may be the last day on Earth, a desperate fight ensues to save a child from a flooding apartment.

metas.name: A Time for Bravery
metas.description: A psychoanalyst is sentenced to community service following a traffic accident and is assigned to provide therapeutic support to a police agent devastated by his wife's infidelity. The two will face unimaginable dangers together.

metas.name: 10 Dance
metas.description: Two expert dancers, Shinya Sugiki and Shinya Suzuki, aim to master each other's styles for a prestigious competition, but old rivalries and potential romance complicate their partnership.

metas.name: Murder in Monaco
metas.description: Monaco, 1999: Billionaire banker Edmond Safra is found dead in his penthouse. The documentary examines the puzzling circumstances surrounding this wealthy financier's murder.

metas.name: Wake Up Dead Man

metas.name: Dust Bunny
metas.description: After losing her foster parents to a bedroom-dwelling beast, young Aurora hires her reclusive neighbor, a professional assassin, to hunt it, unknowingly thrusting him into a war against both human killers and supernatural terrors.

metas.name: Ella McCay
metas.description: An idealistic young woman juggles her family and work life in a comedy about the people you love and how to survive them.

metas.name: Tell Me Softly

metas.name: Silent Night, Deadly Night
metas.description: After seeing his parents killed by someone dressed as Santa, a grown man later wears a Santa suit himself and seeks violent revenge.

metas.name: Not Without Hope
metas.description: A group of friends' fishing boat capsizes during a storm in the Gulf of Mexico and they're left alone stranded at sea and struggling for survival.

metas.name: In the Hand of Dante
metas.description: A handwritten manuscript of Dante Alighieri's poem "The Divine Comedy" makes its way from a priest to a mob boss in New York City, where it is taken by Nick Tosches after he's asked to verify its authenticity.

metas.description: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

metas.name: Merv
metas.description: When their beloved dog Merv loses his spark after their split, Anna and Russ are forced into the world's most awkward co-parenting arrangement.

metas.name: Hamnet
metas.description: In late 16th-century England, Agnes, a healer sensitive to the world around her, builds a home with William, a local tutor and aspiring playwright. As their lives fracture, they are tested by distance, silence, and grief.

metas.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
metas.description: A female assassin seeks revenge on her former lover and squad members, all of whom left her for dead.

metas.name: Hunting Season
metas.description: When a reclusive survivalist and his daughter rescue a mysterious, wounded woman from a river, they become entangled in a deadly web of violence and revenge, forcing them to confront a brutal criminal to survive.

metas.name: Jay Kelly
metas.description: Famous movie actor Jay Kelly embarks on a journey of self-discovery, confronting his past and present with his devoted manager Ron. Poignant and humor-filled, pitched at the intersection of regrets and glories.

metas.name: My Secret Santa

metas.name: Miracle in Cell No. 7
metas.description: A story of love between a mentally-ill father who was wrongly accused of murder and his lovely six year old daughter. Prison will be their home. Based on the 2013 Korean movie Miracle in Cell No. 7 (2013).

metas.name: Troll 2

metas.name: Tinsel Town
metas.description: A washed-up Hollywood action hero takes a role in a small English village's quirky Christmas pantomime, where he finds unexpected inspiration through the show's straight-talking dance instructor.

metas.name: Turbulence
metas.description: A married couple embarks on a hot-air balloon adventure, but unforeseen circumstances lead to life-threatening situations that test their love and resilience as they fight for survival.

metas.name: Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: Kevin Hart: Acting My Age

metas.name: Wicked: For Good

metas.name: The Family Plan 2
metas.description: Now that Dan’s assassin days are behind him, all he wants for Christmas is quality time with his kids. But when he learns his daughter has her own plans, he books a family trip to London—putting them all in the crosshairs of an un...

metas.name: Sisu: Road to Revenge
metas.description: A man returns to dismantle his family's house, where they were murdered in war, to rebuild it elsewhere. When the killer, a Red Army commander, tracks him down, a brutal cross-country pursuit begins.

metas.name: Champagne Problems
metas.description: An executive travels to France to secure the acquisition of a renowned champagne brand before Christmas, but her plans are upended when she falls into a whirlwind romance with a charming Parisian - only to discover he's the founde...

metas.name: The Carman Family Deaths
metas.description: A fishing trip ends in tragedy when Linda Carman vanishes at sea leaving her son Nathan adrift for days. His rescue stirs up questions about his grandfather's murder and ignites a battle over inheritance that leads to shocking rev...

metas.name: O Filho de Mil Homens

metas.name: Now You See Me: Now You Don't

metas.name: Keeper

metas.name: A Very Jonas Christmas Movie

metas.name: Nouvelle Vague

metas.name: A Merry Little Ex-Mas

metas.name: Being Eddie

metas.name: Nuremberg

metas.name: Predator: Badlands
metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

metas.name: Die My Love
metas.description: A writer and young mother is suffering post-partum depression and slowly spiralling into madness. Moving into an old house with her husband, she grows more and more agitated and erratic as her mind begins to unravel.

metas.description: A choral society's male members enlist in World War I, leaving the demanding Dr. Guthrie to recruit teenagers. Together, they experience the joy of singing while the young boys grapple with their impending conscription into the army.

metas.name: Mango
metas.description: Lærke, an ambitious hotel manager, is sent to Malaga to develop a hotel on Alex's mango farm. Lærke's daughter joins, expecting a rare holiday. Unexpected feelings arise between Lærke and Alex, forcing them to make life-altering c...

metas.name: Christy

metas.name: The Secret Agent

metas.name: Worldbreaker

metas.name: The Cut

metas.name: Bugonia

metas.name: Safe House

metas.name: Aileen: Queen of the Serial Killers
